_about: Every converted Workshop car and the edits made to it, so a rebuild or a new car repeats them. pzbatch.py runs pzcar.py from this. 'defaults' apply to every car unless the car says otherwise.

notes: world 1.444: the car at the Defender's approved size against Zomboid's own (Defender = 130% of its model)
seats 15 cm forward of the seat mesh centre, front eyes at mid-windscreen (in pzcar.py)
every seat gets its own door handle; a doorless middle seat is entered by the tailgate
wheels never drop past the suspension's travel; both wheels of an axle hang alike

edits: approved pilot: body fitted over the wheels by its arches, whole car grown so the body is 130% of its model (Josiah 2026-11-01)
built with the older --body sizing; same look as world 1.444
tyres 88% of the script's size (Josiah: wheels too big, 2026-11-01)
mod uses older Zomboid units (model scale 2.13), handled by --world
